prior_findings.note: bambu-05, wx-02 and bambu-gtk-integration now say 'No isolated screenshot is available for this change yet; these earlier combined Linux images mainly show the card-spacing fix.' bambu-03 and bambu-project-startup now say the images do not tell a slow lookup apart from a missed startup request. The cause each PR fixes is already in each body's first sentence. All original image URLs are kept.

The rebuttal holds. wx-02's documented contract is 'set before creating windows', not 'set before the first FromDIP call'. A static cached on first use would quietly lock the feature off if an app or library called FromDIP(sz, NULL) during static init or pre-OnInit startup. wxGTKDIPScale already reads the GTK screen resolution on every call on purpose (d54f3313 src/gtk/window.cpp comment: 'Read it each time so settings changes and other screens use their own DPI'), so the cost is the same kind as work that is already there. The option lookup is still unmeasured, and recording that in the review evidence rather than the body is appropriate.
The bambu-progress body adds 'Stacked after the DPI fixes for merge order; this also applies to master independently.'

findings.title: New alt text calls the stock 'before' image a combined-series image
findings.evidence: bodies-round3/{bambu-05,wx-02,bambu-gtk-integration}.md line 5: '![Combined-series sidebar before the card-spacing fix](.../stock-sidebar-cards-before.png)'. Line 8 says 'these earlier combined Linux images'. The file is named 'stock-' and its earlier published caption (publication/historical/live-prs.json, bambu #8 body) was 'Original printer/plate row'. So it shows the original app without any of this series. Also, 'the card-spacing fix' does not say which PR, and in the wx repository it refers to a PR that reviewers there cannot see.
findings.trigger: A reviewer reads the alt text or caption of one of these three PRs.
findings.outcome: They take the left image to be this series without #8. It is actually stock, so every change in the series differs between the two images, not only the card spacing. Small, but it is the same attribution confusion that DS-R2-01 was meant to remove.
findings.smallest_fix: Alt text: 'Original sidebar' and 'Sidebar with this whole series applied'. Caption: 'No isolated screenshot yet; these images compare the original app with the whole series, where the visible change is mostly the sidebar card spacing (BambuStudio #8).'
findings.verification: Reread the three bodies; the alt text matches the image file names and provenance.
findings.kind: new wording nit introduced by the DS-R2-01 fix; not a code defect
